description: The file 'db_client.h' defines a database client class 'db_client_t' for managing MariaDB/MySQL connections and queries. It includes method declarations for initializing connections, executing queries, retrieving results, and managing database lifecycle. It also includes conditional headers for different Linux environments.

classes.name: db_client_t
classes.description: A class encapsulating MariaDB connection management, query execution, and result retrieval functionalities within a C++ interface.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database using a specified path formatted as 'username@password'.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the database connection environment, preparing for database operations.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a given SQL query on the connected database and returns a result context.

methods.name: next_result
methods.description: Checks if there is another result available from the previous query execution; frees result context if false.

methods.name: get_string
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from a specific column in the query result, storing it into a provided buffer.

methods.name: get_number
methods.description: Retrieves an integer value from a specific column in the query result.

methods.name: recreate_db
methods.description: Recreates the database structure, deleting existing data; use with caution.

methods.name: db_client_t
methods.description: Constructor initializing internal members; connection must be established separately.

methods.name: ~db_client_t
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up database resources, ensuring proper disconnection.
